about.back: about page: the header link back to the map page
card.air: card row label: air temperature, wind, uv index, chance of rain
card.at: after the card's sea row: the hour those numbers are for; h = HH:00
card.at_best: card headline after the score for a picked hour; best = the beach's best hour, score = the score there
card.best_at: card headline after the score: the beach's best hour; h = HH:00
card.close: accessible name of the beach card's × button
card.current: card sea row: surface current speed; v = number with km/h
card.enterococci: a water sampling point's bacteria count per 100 millilitres
card.good: card 'why' row when no note lowered the score
card.past: card badge when the hour shown is earlier than now, today
card.rain: card air row: chance of rain; pct = a whole number
card.sea: card row label: sea temperature, waves, swell, current
card.source: under the card's water-quality row; source = the agency's name, e.g. IMA/SC
card.swell: card sea row: swell height; v = number with m
card.tide: card row label: the day's high and low tides
card.uv: card air row: the uv index
card.water: card row label: the agency's bathing-water classification (balneabilidade)
card.whales_now: card whales row; level = one of lvl.*, peak = the daylight hour with the best odds, season = yes in the humpback season on the brazilian coast (july to november)
card.where: card row label: the beach's coordinates, linking to OpenStreetMap
card.why: card row label: the notes behind the score
cell.jellyfish: tooltip cell: jellyfish likelihood; level = one of lvl.*
cell.water: tooltip cell: sea water temperature; v = number with °C
cell.waves: wave height, then the wave period when known; m = height with m, s = seconds between waves with s
cell.whales: tooltip cell: whale-sighting likelihood; level = one of lvl.*, peak = the hour (HH:00) with the day's best odds, shown when it is not the hour on display
cell.wind: wind speed when the board has no calm/breezy/strong band, and in the card's air row; v = number with km/h
chat.close: chat panel: accessible name of the × close button
chat.offline: chat panel: shown when the chatbot endpoint does not answer; the command line and the mcp tool are the other ways to ask
chat.open: floating button that opens the chat panel; an invitation, keep it short
chat.placeholder: chat input placeholder: an example question a swimmer would ask
chat.title: chat panel heading, same wording as chat.open
common.na: a value the forecast did not have, in place of a number; keep it as short as one
controls.area: accessible name of the area (city/coast) picker
controls.day: accessible name of the today/tomorrow day buttons group
controls.list: button that shows or hides the ranked list of beaches
controls.near: button that sorts the list by distance from the visitor; one to three words
controls.near_title: tooltip of controls.near: the location never leaves the browser
controls.sound: button that toggles an ambient wave sound; keep the 🌊 emoji first
controls.sound_title: tooltip of controls.sound: synthesized locally, never autoplays
day.today: day button label for the first day on the board
day.tomorrow: day button label for the second day on the board
dir.e: compass point the wind blows from, abbreviated (east, leste)
dir.n: compass point the wind blows from, abbreviated; stays uppercase on the page
dir.ne: compass point the wind blows from, abbreviated
dir.nw: compass point the wind blows from, abbreviated (northwest, noroeste)
dir.s: compass point the wind blows from, abbreviated
dir.se: compass point the wind blows from, abbreviated
dir.sw: compass point the wind blows from, abbreviated (southwest, sudoeste)
dir.w: compass point the wind blows from, abbreviated (west, oeste)
fac.lifeguard: tooltip: how many lifeguard posts OSM maps within 300 m of the beach
fac.parking: tooltip: how many parking areas OSM maps within 300 m of the beach
fac.shower: tooltip: how many beach showers OSM maps within 300 m of the beach
fac.toilets: tooltip: how many public toilets OSM maps within 300 m of the beach
fail.load: status line when the board fails to load; error = technical detail (http status and path, keep as is), hint = yes when the board file is missing, which usually means a local checkout that has not built it; `just site-build` is a command
fail.no_areas: status line when the site was built with no areas; data/areas.json is a file path
fail.schema: status line when the board file is in a format this page does not read; got = its version number, want = the versions the page reads
footer.blurb: map footer: how the score is made and the privacy promise; ends with a dash followed by the footer.github link
footer.generated: map footer status line; when = timestamp, area = area name, day = ISO date, n = beach count, sources = provider names
footer.github: map footer: link text to the repository
footer.privacy: about page footer: the privacy promise
gh.label: accessible name of the GitHub pill in the nav (its text is hidden on phones)
gh.star: short word inside the GitHub pill inviting a star; one word
gh.title: hover tooltip of the GitHub pill
header.tagline: one-line description under the marola wordmark; concrete nouns, no adjectives about the product
hour.at: hour slider label when a specific hour is picked; h = HH:00, past = yes when that hour has passed today
hour.best: hour slider label when each beach shows its own best hour (the default)
hour.slider: accessible name of the hour range slider
lang.label: accessible name of the pt/en language toggle group
legend.no_data: legend band: a source did not answer, grey
legend.score: legend heading before the colour bands (the 0-100 swimming score)
legend.unfit: legend band: score 0, water unfit for bathing, red
legend.wave_key: legend hint: hovering a wave marker shows the beach's details
list.dark: list row, in place of the hour: the beach has no daylight at the picked hour
lore.creature: footer, before the day's paragraph about a sea creature
lore.fact: footer, before the day's sea-lore paragraph
lore.source: footer: link text, shown in brackets, to where the lore paragraph comes from
lvl.high: jellyfish or whale-sighting likelihood, the highest of three
lvl.low: jellyfish or whale-sighting likelihood; pt agrees with an implied 'chance', feminine
lvl.moderate: jellyfish or whale-sighting likelihood, the middle of three
map.label: accessible name of the map
nav.about: section nav: link to the about page
nav.alerts: section nav: alerts section, not built yet
nav.contact: section nav: contact section, not built yet
nav.docs: section nav: link to the published documentation
nav.donate: section nav: donations/support section, not built yet
nav.label: accessible name of the section nav
nav.news: section nav: news section, not built yet
nav.soon: small badge next to a section that has no page yet; shown uppercase by CSS
near.denied: alert after 'near me' when the visitor refuses the location prompt
near.unsupported: alert after 'near me' when the browser has no location api
near.you: tooltip on the visitor's own dot on the map
noscript: shown only without javascript; followed by a link to data/
note.breezy: scoring note, milder than strong wind; wind_kmh = wind speed, whole number
note.choppy: scoring note, milder than rough seas; wave_m = wave height in metres, one decimal
note.cold_water: scoring note; sea_temp_c = sea temperature, one decimal
note.dark: scoring note: the hour has no daylight
note.jellyfish_elevated: scoring note: the jellyfish heuristic says high
note.jellyfish_some: scoring note: the jellyfish heuristic says moderate
note.no_sea_temp_data: scoring note: the forecast had no sea temperature
note.no_wave_data: scoring note: the forecast had no wave height
note.no_wind_data: scoring note: the forecast had no wind speed
note.rain_likely: scoring note; rain_pct = chance of rain, whole number
note.rough_seas: scoring note; wave_m = wave height in metres, one decimal
note.strong_wind: scoring note; wind_kmh = wind speed, whole number
note.warm_water: scoring note; sea_temp_c = sea temperature, one decimal
note.water_mixed: scoring note: some sampling points are fit and some are not; avoid = the unfit points, joined by semicolons; PRÓPRIA is the agency's verdict, kept verbatim
note.water_stale: scoring note: the latest bathing-water sample is too old to trust; sampled_on = its date, day and short month
note.water_unfit: scoring note: the agency classified the water unfit; source = agency, sampled_on = sample date, point and location = the sampling point's name and place, enterococci_per_100ml = bacteria count or na when unknown
status.loading: status line while the page loads
status.loading_named: status line while one area or day loads; name = area name or ISO date
tide.high: one high tide in the card: time = HH:mm, m = signed height against mean sea level
tide.hourly: after the tide list: times come from an hourly series, so they are good to half an hour
tide.low: one low tide in the card: time = HH:mm, m = signed height against mean sea level
tide.none: card tide row when the forecast has no sea level for the beach
tip.at: wave tooltip heading after the beach name: the swimming score out of 100 and the hour it is for (HH:00)
tip.dark: tooltip heading and card headline when the beach has no daylight at the picked hour, so no score
title.about: browser tab title of the about page
title.map: browser tab title of the map page
water.no_data: the water-quality summary when no agency covers the beach, or none answered
water.unclassified: a water sampling point the agency has classified neither PRÓPRIA nor IMPRÓPRIA
wind.breezy: wind band shown before the km/h number: between calm and strong
wind.calm: wind band shown before the km/h number: the calmest of three
wind.strong: wind band shown before the km/h number: the windiest of three
